notes.title: Steel Sword Story S Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As we promised, the classic 2D side-scrolling action game Steel Sword Story has been upgraded and updated to Steel Sword Story S today!

The original version will remain playable after the update by selecting it in the Steam launcher.

*If you already owned the original game before the update but can't play the S version, please restart the Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/00f5735ae5c3eb58017f79fcc7fe92c01b6a8f00.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Trading Cards[/h1]

We've also added Steam-exclusive trading cards and badges!
Try to collect all the Steam items by playing the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/de016ca5c7bebf8af54296b442ee00ff822b248e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34011329/a4524d354ec58b4ab42ee377b1667df483242871.png[/img]

[h1]Price Adjustment[/h1]

As previously announced, the price of the game has increased alongside the update, from $4.99 to $9.99.
If you already owned Steel Sword Story before the update, you can play both the original and the S version starting today.

Please enjoy the newly evolved action experience!

[h1]SSSS x PGMMV Bundle[/h1]

Yhe project data for the original Steel Sword Story is included in the game folder, and it's still there after the update. If you're a Pixel Game Maker MV game developer, you could enjoy Steel Sword Story both as a game and as a project you can always open and reference whenever you want. 

Buy the game and its engine with these nice bundle deals!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/837510/MV/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40937/SSSS_x_PGMMV_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40938/MV/


[url=https://playism.com/news/2024/0604/1577/]For more details, please refer to the PLAYISM website.[/url]

notes.title: Out of Early Access! Pixel Game Maker MV 1.0.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We are proud to announce the release of the v1.0.0 of Pixel Game Maker MV!
We received a lot of constructive feedback during the Early Access, and it helped us to improve the software greatly.

In addition to our coming out of the Early Access period, we are also about to release a 30-day trial version of Pixel Game Maker MV! 

Also, don't forget about the upcoming [b]Pixel Game Maker MV Game Development Challenge![/b]
The contest will start on [b]October 3rd[/b], and the winner will have their submission released on the Nintendo Switch. Any combination of art style and genre are welcome!
For more info, please visit our Itch.io page from October 3rd.
Please give it a try! We are looking forward to seeing your projects!

October 3rd will also see a physical release of Pixel Game Maker MV in Japan, but Steam users shall not be forgotten! To celebrate the launch, Pixel Game Maker is [b]now 30% off![/b]

Finally, 1.0.0 is not the final update for Pixel Game Maker MV!
We spent our time in Early Access focused on building a stable platform, and we feel that we have finally achieved that goal.
Going forward, our focus will be on addressing user requests for quality of life and functional enhancements, such as UI refinements or the addition of functionality like a database system.
Please stay excited for these future updates as we continue onwards!

Thank you for your support of Pixel Game Maker MV!

[h1]■Updates[/h1]

[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated the End User License Agreement
[*]Added the Steel Sword Story (Demo) and La Mulana 2 sample projects
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes (Player)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could cause Objects to be detected as being incorrectly in the air when on a Slope
[/list]

"How to switch to Branches"
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select the Beta tab and select the target version and close Properties.

"How to switch to Default"
Please execute the following process to revert from other versions to the current release.
1. Open "Properties" for Pixel Game Maker MV in your Steam Library.
2. Select "None - don't participate in any Beta programs" and close Properties.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/837510/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__MV/

notes.title: Bug Fix Update ver1.01
notes.notes:
Hello All,

Thank you very much for playing Ver. 1.0 and for your outstanding feedback.
We also greatly appreciate everyone's bug reports.
Based on reports we've received from multiple players, we've fixed certain bugs and have updated the game to Ver. 1.01.
Please download the latest updated version.

Bug Fixes
・ Fix bug door does not open
・ Fix bug players sometimes get buried in the ground during the boss battle.

Please be sure to download the latest version, and we hope you continue to enjoy Steel Sword Story!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978190/Steel_Sword_Story/

notes.title: Made in PGMMV: Steel Sword Story Full Version Set for Release on June 21st!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The full version of 2D side-scrolling action game Steel Sword Story, created in Pixel Game Maker MV and currently available in Trial Ver. form, is scheduled for release on [b]June 21st (Fri.)[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/87502806eb0d5bb5653a513753446fd5dc9099ec.gif[/img]

[i]A true old-school 2D action game to bring back memories of the good old days.[/i]

[h1][b]■Save the kingdom - armed with with nothing but your rusty, old steel sword![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/2fba868bbc2521c263c43d2c3f152ef4322d06ab.gif[/img]

Having lost everything his status and been forced into exile, Azul faces off against the threat encroaching upon the kingdom with nothing but his rusty, old steel sword!

[h1][b]■Fight off waves of enemies[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/3191dfcb1976495db983a8c883a7429c02f1f1f6.gif[/img]

Your foes will come at you with all sorts of attacks!
Deftly evade injury - and death - and take each and every one of them down! 

[h1][b]■Hardcore Boss Fights[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/639fe969dea346bc35b5093bf08be69b110cf059.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34011329/b6ccd7d1c33701fc3855fbc79466e24af9d9f7a6.gif[/img]

The boss battles are insane!
Grab your sword and conjure up some magic and fight to the death!

Steel Sword Story, while compact in size, is a surprisingly deeply crafted and fulfilling, high-quality game.
It's also extremely budget-friendly! Stick it in your Wishlist today and get ready for the full release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978190/Steel_Sword_Story/

---

notes.title: Steel Sword Story Demo Version Available Now!
notes.notes:
Hi All

We are proud to announce that the demo version of Steel Sword Story, a side-scroller 2D action game, is out now on Steam!
Steel Sword Story is being developed by 8bits Fanatics, the creator of 1001 Spikes, using the game creation software [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/837510/Pixel_Game_Maker_MV__MV/]Pixel Game Maker MV.[/url]

Check out the demo version now, and add Steel Sword Story to your wishlist now to be notified upon the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/978190/Steel_Sword_Story/
